blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In the warehouse we count boxes and pallets. One box, two boxes, three boxes. We can count them. They are countable.

But we cannot count sugar or coffee one by one. We measure them. Sugar and coffee are uncountable. We say "some sugar" and "a lot of coffee", not "two sugars".

English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. We start slow. Today you learn 5 words: box, pallet, bag, label and tape. You use a or an with one countable noun. You use some with an uncountable noun. A bag of sugar makes sugar countable. You can do it!

items.q: What can we count in the warehouse?
items.why: "we count boxes and pallets" — são substantivos contáveis.

items.q: Why do we NOT count sugar one by one?
options: Because it is inside a box
Because it is uncountable — we measure it
items.why: "we cannot count sugar or coffee one by one. We measure them."

items.q: Which word do we use with an uncountable noun?
items.why: "You use some with an uncountable noun" (some sugar, some coffee).

items.q: The text says "A bag of sugar makes sugar countable." This suggests that…
options: You can count bags, even if you cannot count sugar
Sugar is never in a bag
Sugar and bags mean the same thing
items.why: Inferência: você não conta o açúcar, mas conta as sacas (one bag, two bags).

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: You can learn step by step and you can do it
English is too hard for you
You should learn everything in one day
Counting is not important in a warehouse
items.why: Inferência: o tom é de incentivo — "We start slow… You can do it!"

blocks.instruction: Ouça você ajudando um novo colega no armazém. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the warehouse. My name is Paulo. Today I help you with the boxes and the pallets. It is easy. We start slow, okay?

Look here. This is a box. We count boxes: one, two, three, four. And this is a pallet. We put many boxes on one pallet. Boxes and pallets are countable. We can count them with numbers.

Now look at this bag. Inside the bag we have sugar. We do not count sugar one by one. We say "some sugar" or "a lot of sugar". But we can count the bags. One bag, two bags, three bags. That is easy, right? A bag helps us count.

Every box needs a label. The label shows where the box goes. Please put a label on this box, on the top. And we use tape to close the box. Strong tape is important for safe packing. Good packing saves money for the company.

So remember two simple rules. We count boxes, bags and pallets. We measure sugar and coffee. You can do it! Do you have any questions? No? Great. Let's start now with these five boxes here.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does the speaker help the new colleague with today?
items.why: "Today I help you with the boxes and the pallets."

items.q: What is inside the bag?
items.why: "Inside the bag we have sugar."

items.q: What does a label do?
options: It shows where the box goes
items.why: "The label shows where the box goes."

items.q: The speaker says we can count the bags but not the sugar. This suggests that…
options: A bag is a way to count sugar
items.why: Inferência: o açúcar é incontável, mas em sacas você consegue contar (one bag, two bags).

items.q: How would you best describe the speaker's tone?
items.why: Inferência: "It is easy. We start slow… You can do it!" — tom amigável e paciente.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please put the small parts in this box." A box is…
items.why: Box = caixa. É contável: one box, two boxes.

items.q: "We put many boxes on one pallet." A pallet is…
items.why: Pallet = palete, a base onde empilhamos as caixas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There is a lot of sugar in this ___."
items.why: Bag = saca/saco. Colocamos o açúcar em uma saca.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Write the address on the ___ so we know where the box goes."
items.why: Label = etiqueta. Ela mostra para onde a caixa vai.

items.q: "Use strong tape to close the box." Tape is…
items.why: Tape = fita adesiva. É incontável: some tape, a lot of tape.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples do dia a dia do armazém. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please fill in the label with the address." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher, escrever a informação (no campo/etiqueta).

items.q: "Can you pick up that box for me?" To pick up means to…
items.why: Pick up = pegar, levantar algo.

items.q: "We run out of tape." This means we…
items.why: Run out of = ficar sem, acabou o estoque.

items.q: "Let's put together five boxes for this pallet." To put together means to…
items.why: Put together = montar, preparar um conjunto.

items.q: "Good packing helps us save money." To save money means to…
items.why: Save money = economizar, gastar menos.
